data.text: Picture circus-tent structures going up over a one-gigawatt construction site in New Albany, Ohio, built that way on purpose because tents cut deployment time by 70 to 80% versus permanent buildings. That is Prometheus, and it is already training Meta's Muse Wonder models on https://t.co/lvqmOFvELx

SpaceX flew a wheel of cheese on its very first Dragon capsule in December 2010 as a nod to Monty Python's Cheese Shop sketch. Sixteen years later Elon is posting a remake of that same sketch where the shopkeeper sells GPUs.

The joke lands because it's his real life. He says https://t.co/mBugz2ebEp

$META just trained its Muse models on a gigawatt-scale cluster.

Gigawatt. That's a power plant, not a data center.

The AI race is now an energy race:
$NVDA sells the chips
$META burns the power
Utilities quietly win

Who's the most underrated AI stock right now? https://t.co/PsnfKxda5k

Do you know why I am looking at $NBIS instead of IREN?

I do not blindly support a stock just because it has big projects on paper or keeps announcing expansion plans. As an independent investor, I focus on where pricing power sits in the value chain, how much the actual assets https://t.co/yqeC3jXsWW

Meta named its Ohio AI cluster Prometheus. bold name for a building full of fire. everything to know:

• phase 1 done, scaling to ~1M GPUs
• each 72-GPU rack runs 64, keeps 8 spare
• interruptions down 99% from peak

the original got an eagle. this one gets firmware updates https://t.co/4ziDksHpJC

I think the whole "AI power shortage is overstated" argument is another case of someone discovering a spreadsheet and deciding industrial engineering is basically solved. 

Apparently ERCOT has 27GW coming, some Bitcoin miners can swap their ASICs for GPUs easy peazy, a few https://t.co/hnQwaAfFQo

Mistral just dropped Timestral, a family of tiny time series foundation models (5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters) that takes #1 on every major zero shot forecasting benchmark while running purely on a CPU in milliseconds.

While the industry spent the last two years scaling LLM https://t.co/vyCEuro5Fd
